summary: standardize on OpenRouter canonical model ids + pre-load pricing for major providers
description:
Two related changes:

1. Standardize internal model_id on OpenRouter's canonical form.
   Today MODELS.pro = 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5' (hyphenated, our
   internal alias) but OpenRouter's /api/v1/models lists it as
   'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5' (dotted). Both work for completions
   but the listing-vs-completion asymmetry forced a mapping layer in
   sync-pricing.ts. Drop the alias: rename MODELS.pro and the
   existing model_pricing + queries rows to the dotted form.

2. Pre-load model_pricing for major providers via a provider-prefix
   allowlist instead of per-model curation.  When OpenRouter exposes
   a new model from anthropic/openai/etc., the next sync-pricing run
   picks it up automatically — useful for future per-user model
   selection or new tier additions, no script change needed.

Provider allowlist (selected from OpenRouter's catalog by frontier-
model relevance): anthropic, openai, x-ai, deepseek, google,
meta-llama, mistralai, qwen.

Done when:
- migrations/007_normalize_model_ids.sql renames hyphenated rows to
  dotted in model_pricing and queries
- src/lib/model.ts MODELS.pro uses the dotted form
- scripts/sync-pricing.ts uses a provider-prefix allowlist; the old
  { srcId, openrouterId } mapping shape is gone (no longer needed)
- FALLBACK_PRICING keeps coverage for routed models (deepseek-chat,
  claude-sonnet-4.5) — the rest are best-effort via OpenRouter
- Tests + tsc + build clean
- After deploy: 'npm run sync-pricing' lands rows for all major
  providers; queries.model_used + model_pricing.model_id agree on
  the dotted form
